author: National Geographic
description:
Facing the death of his country’s glaciers and the loss of his beloved grandparents, Icelandic writer Andri Snær Magnason turns his archives into a time capsule to hold what is slipping away — family, memory, time, and water. Time and Water premieres on National Geographic July 31 and will stream on Disney+ and Hulu August 1.
